rules.name: spot-case-verify-dev
rules.sql: SELECT m.spot AS config_spot, min(u.underlying_id) AS price_spot, count(*) AS rows_affected FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u ON u.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') GROUP BY m.spot ORDER BY m.spot

SELECT p.curr_mult_factor AS config_spot, min(u.underlying_id) AS price_spot, count(*) AS products FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u ON u.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor) AND u.underlying_id <> p.curr_mult_factor WHERE p.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113') GROUP BY p.curr_mult_factor ORDER BY p.curr_mult_factor

expect.reason: every mapping spot has the price table spelling
every product curr_mult_factor has the price table spelling
